meta.note: Names, descriptions, grades and PSN targets cross-checked between PSNProfiles and Output Lag on 19 Nov 2026; the two agree on every name, description and grade. Guides are written in the author's own words from those sources.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own — there is no separate task. It is the reward for finishing the whole list, so plan around the long grinds (100% completion, 300 stunts) since they decide when this unlocks.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion using the in-game checklist under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, which only appears after the story. Work counts from the start, so do robberies, collectibles and activities as you go instead of leaving them all for the end. The checklist needs 300 stunts, 70 of 80 Challenges, 39 gang operations and the rest — see the Roadmap's 100% list for every number.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts: stunt jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count. Keep going past 250 — 100% completion needs 300. Stunts you do naturally while playing count, so this mostly fills itself if you drive boldly.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the two ranges. Treat each range as a separate practice session and learn the target patterns before chasing gold.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults unlock through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is near the end of Chapter 4 — tail an armored van to a large bank and get in while the guard has the vault open. Bring your partner: you cannot carry all the bags alone, and escaping together also earns Hot Together. 100% needs all 8 vaults.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 qualifying mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only some questlines count — Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's do not, because they have their own trophies. Check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are found across Leonida; 100% completion needs 15 of the 18 sets, so keep collecting past the three.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations. Scan landmarks and vehicles as you travel — the app counts a scan each time you use it somewhere new. Do it as you go and it fills up without a dedicated grind.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Sample everything early — races, arcade games, fishing, gym, pool, mini golf, basketball and the rest — so you know what each activity is before the long grinds.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. 100% needs 30 of 40 races won, so keep racing past 20. Vary the race types — street, off-road and drone-adjacent events all feed different totals.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. The easiest moment is a bank vault job, which gives you 4 stars straight away — escape with your partner beside you and it pops once you leave the red heat zone.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Call your partner first, then hit three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you — if the stars fade to only the red heat zone, the chain breaks. It can take about 30 seconds to pop after the third shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive. 100% needs 200 of the 277 base models.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — 52 map areas. Drive every road and visit every region; the map fills in as you go, and the trophy pops once the last area is uncovered.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this pops along the way. Operations are marked on the map once you find them.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs; sell them to your contacts and the total is cumulative.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location (14). Win at least one race at each spot; 100% needs all 42 Drone Time Trials across the same 14 locations.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every kind of shop — it fills up naturally as you buy weapons, clothes, food and gear.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000. Garages the story gives you do not count.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing unlocks early — find Cal, take the challenge, and win it. A good first trophy to grab in Chapter 1.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Any of the four in-game games counts. 100% wants all four played, so try each one while you are there.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida (18). Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close. THE MISSABLE ONE: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 — after the mission Down to Earth, follow her to the balcony in the morning and accept — disappears once Chapter 1 ends, and there is no mission replay. Each outdoor spot counts twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner. Keep a Chapter 1 save until it pops.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus — the slow-motion aim (L3+R3 while aiming). Pick a group of gang enemies, such as guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle. Adrenaline extends Focus.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry robberies. Use it on a store's locked back door — kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside, find the note with the safe code, open the safe and leave unseen. If someone spots you, reload.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Tail an armored security van, hit it, and get clear — it only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges, listed under Progress > Challenges. 100% needs 70 of the 80, and many complete on their own while you play.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission, Gone Fishing. Unmissable — it pops as you play the start of the story.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Unmissable — story progress. Note: chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Unmissable — story progress. PlayStation prints this name censored with asterisks; the full name is 'Tits Ass Drug Money'.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Unmissable — story progress.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Unmissable — story progress.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Unmissable — story progress. Keep an untouched manual save from just before it: there is no mission replay, and a save lets you revisit the finale.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete Breakfast Run. Unmissable — story progress. Finishing it opens switching between Jason and Lucia, which the partner trophies need.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist. Unmissable — story progress.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play. Unmissable — story progress.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners. Unmissable — story progress.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown. Unmissable — story progress.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory. Unmissable — story progress.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Side-story finale — it stays available after the credits, so there is no rush.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Side-story finale (Billy's strand is Jason-only). Stays available after the credits.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Side-story finale (Andy's strand is Lucia-only). Stays available after the credits.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Side-story finale — stays available after the credits.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Side-story finale (Tyrone's strand is Jason-only). Stays available after the credits.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and sends you after animals through target decks. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine. 100% needs all 15 Target Deck objectives.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. At Vice City International Airport, steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge (gates E3 and E4 work; planes parked on the airfield do not count). Go to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off. It is delayed: fly about 1 km from the airport and it pops. Save first — the police come fast.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos — get into a military tank. Tanks are parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until it pops.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. The alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs. Take all three key valuables — the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, blown open with a Sticky Bomb — then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — Jason and Lucia both reach maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there; the partner trains alongside you.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse) — 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch — the description is the only hint, and it may pop while you play normally. Marked unverified: do not trust unconfirmed methods. Check the sources for updates once players confirm it.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch. The description suggests a showroom escape, but no method is confirmed — marked unverified, do not guess.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch. Marked unverified — the description is the only hint.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch. Marked unverified — the description is the only hint.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch; the precise method is still being confirmed. Marked unverified — do not trust unconfirmed methods.
